condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

claims.conclusion: PUT XML; Request-URI is a users-tree XCAP URI with configured group-creation XUI.
Determine sender identity. Unauthorized: 403 and stop. XML group/list-service/@uri violates local policy: 409 uniqueness-failure with acceptable alt-value(s), then stop.

conditions: GMC receives 409 with uniqueness-failure containing at least one alt-value
claims.conclusion: May retry using a suggested group ID, not a replacement addressing XUI; not mandatory or successful creation.

limitations: Not complete XML, authentication or RFC4825 behavior.
